create.meaning: Observed resource identity used by the selected lifecycle.
create.rationale: The selected record names the resource requested by the caller.

requirement.sourceQuote: Prepare the development network. Reuse the shared network when it exists; otherwise allocate the requested new network. Check readiness at most three times with five seconds delay. On readiness failure remove only the allocation returned by successful creation and propagate failure; preserve shared networks. Do not rotate secrets.
